title: Create Ro World
description: A WIP modpack for primarily aimed at a survival experience with create mod trains, factories, and cute decoration.
body:
## Create
This modpack comes packed full of all the best create mods including Create Aeronautics, Big Cannons, Steam n Rails, and many more!

## Environment
There are many mods focusing on decorations, landscape/biomes, and prettier mobs.

## Quality of Life
- A custom vanilla tweaks resource pack has been added for even better resources. 
- Two optional 'no spider' resource packs have been included for those with arachnophobia. One replaces both spiders and cave spiders with different coloured slimes, and the other replaces them with 2D spiders.

## Multiplayer
Created for me and a group of friends to play survival create together, this modpack is made with multiplayer in mind.

Credits: Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
